_about: Keeping a career safe beyond this browser: when to remind the owner to keep a backup. Read by src/ui/career/saveSafety.ts.

backup._remindAfterDays: Days since the last backup (code copied, file saved or a code loaded) before the quiet reminder shows again.
backup._progressWeeks: Weeks played before a career counts as worth a reminder; a brand-new career has nothing to lose yet.
backup._fileName: Backup files are named <fileSlug>-backup-YYYY-MM-DD.txt, by the phone's local date.
backup._maxFileMB: A chosen backup file bigger than this is refused before it is read. A real save code is far smaller.
